question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"travel".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** "Travel" **means to go from one place to another, usually over a distance.
 
• The verb form of **"travel" **is **"travelling" **in British English and **"traveling" **in American En
